verdict.rationale: Through its Lowenstein x Clerky partnership, founders can incorporate a Delaware C corp online and self-serve real incorporation documents: bylaws, director/officer appointments, founder stock issuances and 83(b) forms. A paid Post-Incorporation Setup also captures founder vesting and IP details, so this is genuine interactive assembly rather than static templates. However, the tooling is a third-party partner platform rather than a firm-built product, and it is evidenced only for formation workflows. Missing for 10: first-party firm-owned automation, coverage beyond incorporation and post-incorporation setup (e.g., financings, employment docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the online assembly experience.
